'''Tikk''' was an [[uvak]] that belonged to [[Sith Tyro]] [[Vestara Khai]]. Khai obtained Tikk in a [[Uvak competition|competition]] in [[37 ABY|37.5 ABY]] and subsequently used Tikk as transportation on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]], on which she lived with the other members of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. Tikk was present when Khai first encountered a [[Sith Meditation Sphere]] named [[Ship (Sith Meditation Sphere)|Ship]] in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. Tikk was almost killed when Khai first became a [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lady]] [[Olaris Rhea|Rhea]]. As a test, Khai was forced to watch as her uvak was taken from her and had an activated [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] raised above his neck. Instead of attempting to rescue Tikk, Khai suppressed her emotions, and Rhea thus spared the uvak's life.

In [[44 ABY]], [[Gavar Khai]], Vestara's father, [[Death/Legends|executed]] Tikk because he felt Tikk was no longer needed since Vestara was no longer around. In order to minimize the pain, Khai [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] the uvak.
